limitation: This review is structured role separation by one Codex agent, not independent human or multi-person signoff. The user's authorization to complete the remaining M6 tasks is interpreted only as permission for this deterministic repair-routing contract.

user_confirmation.confirmation_note: The user authorized continued M6 work while requiring explicit escalation for any approval-gated expansion. This implementation remains execution-free.

checks: RepairTicket binds exact origin EvidenceRequest and CandidateBundle ids/digests.
Repair routing cannot mutate a request, bundle, parser fact, promotion decision, judgment pack or planning input.
A RepairAttempt is append-style immutable planning evidence and carries an exact ticket digest.
Internal metadata/context gaps may only reuse the request's declared preferred/fallback routes.
No free-search route, public proxy or source-policy replacement is generated.
External source exhaustion and commercial-license boundaries are terminal typed stops.
Ticket attempt budget is policy bounded.
Planned attempts are not execution and do not call M5.4/M5.5, a tool, provider, network or SourceHunter adapter.
A router cannot create or overwrite a ToolSelectionPlan; M6.2 remains its sole write owner.
A repair ticket is neither evidence nor promotion.
Parser/Numeric and Evidence Gate owners remain M6.5/M6.6.
Commercial gaps cannot be disguised as exact public evidence.
Internal, external and commercial typed-gap fixtures are deterministic.
Wrong request/bundle linkage, terminal-ticket attempt and over-budget attempt fail closed.
No persistence, case mutation, legacy authority change, writer or full-chain is admitted.

resolved_findings.finding: A repair loop could change its originating request or re-open an unbounded search.
resolved_findings.repair: Ticket carries exact immutable request/bundle refs, bounded declared route scope and an explicit stop reason; no planner writer is exposed.

resolved_findings.finding: Commercial or exhausted external source gaps could silently fall back to public proxy evidence.
resolved_findings.repair: Policy returns terminal commercial_license_required or external_source_exhausted stops with attempt budget zero.

resolved_findings.finding: A planned repair attempt could be misrepresented as a live SourceHunter attempt.
resolved_findings.repair: The only M6.4 attempt state is planned_not_executed and result counters remain zero for tool/network/provider/store writes.

open_followups: Actual SourceHunter/official-source attempt execution requires a separate M6.2 executor, M5.4/M5.5 transaction-bound admission and explicit user approval.
M6.5 owns parser/numeric outputs; M6.6 owns promotion; neither can be inferred from a ticket.
M6.8 later owns Lead repair governance and context handoff.
